item.title: A massive tree from the nearby train station overhangs my home's courtyard., 17th September
item.description:
Madam, I am writing to report a large tree growing on Transport for London land at Golders Green Underground Station. The tree overhangs the courtyard/garden of my property at: 84 Chandos Way London NW11 7HF The tree is causing the following problems: 1. Large quantities of leaves and dead/dry branches regularly fall into my courtyard. 2. The tree’s size and canopy block sunlight from reaching my own trees and plants, which is affecting their growth. I request that TfL inspect the tree and arrange for it to be pruned back to the boundary (or removed if it is considered appropriate after inspection). I am happy to provide photographs and to meet an officer on site if required. Please acknowledge receipt of this complaint and advise me of the next steps and expected timescales. Yours faithfully, Saeed Alghamdi 84 Chandos Way, London NW11 7HF 07447442002 Snsg10000@gmail.com

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Corringway, Golders Green, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: The road is on two different levels with a deep ridge down the middle of the road, 17th September
item.description:
It looks like there has been an attempt to remedy this issue previously with tarmac but the road is worsening. The car physically tips to one side as you drive over the damaged area and the parts that are not covered with tarmac are a serious trip hazard for any pedestrians crossing at this point (see photos) as the difference in levels is easily approx 3 inches (8cm) in places. This issue has been there for at least a year and nothing has been fixed.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hollies Avenue, Longlands, Greater London
